jobs.description_text: PROCESS OPERATOR SPECIALIST, AIR SEPARATION UNIT (STARSHIP) SpaceX is building its first production-scale Air Separation Unit (ASU) at Starbase to produce the high-purity liquid oxygen that powers Starship. This is not just another industrial plant—it is the critical on-site propellant factory that eliminates supply risk for the most ambitious launch vehicle ever built and lays the operational foundation for producing propellants on the Moon and Mars. As a process operator specialist on the ASU team, you will operate and support cryogenic distillation, turboexpanders, centrifugal compressors, molecular sieve systems, and high-purity LOX production under the direction of Lead and Level 4/5 operators. jobs.title: Sr. Aerodynamics Engineer (Starship)
jobs.description_text: SR. AERODYNAMICS ENGINEER (STARSHIP) The Starship Aerodynamics team is responsible for predicting the aerodynamics and aerothermal environments booster and ship experience during all phases of their missions. Aerodynamics engineers use engineering models, simulations and wind-tunnel testing in order to provide the most accurate predictions ahead of flight validation. The team works closely with the GNC (guidance, navigation, and control) team in order to enable them to safely land and recover both Starship stages once their mission is accomplished. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starshield's global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help us further our ambitious goals. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and provides fast, reliable internet to 10M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. SpaceX Gateways are responsible for delivering internet from the ground to the satellites – they must be cost effective, capable of high performance in all weather conditions, and reliable over long periods of time. In addition, we're developing our own high-voltage power supplies to drive unparalleled performance in these high-frequency, high-bandwidth amplification systems critical to our mission. jobs.title: Structural Engineer, Starship Tower
jobs.description_text: STRUCTURAL ENGINEER, STARSHIP TOWER The Starship catch tower will redefine ground support systems for launch vehicles as we know them, with the ultimate goal of launching, catching, and relaunching orbital boosters in hours or days instead of weeks or months. The tower the largest steel structure ever built to support a launch vehicle. It must survive the acoustic, thermal, and blast environment of the most powerful rocket in the world at liftoff, absorb the loads of catching a returning booster, and then be ready to do it again within days. As the Structural Engineer on the Tower team, you will own the structural integrity of these structures from concept through fabrication, erection, activation, and launch operations. You will perform and own the structural design and analysis of primary and secondary steel, connections, anchorage, and foundation interfaces; develop and issue drawings, calculations, and specifications; and lead consulting engineers, fabricators, and construction contractors through engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning. You will work hand in hand with the mechanical, mechanisms, fluids, and analysis engineers on the team to ensure the structure meets requirements for both the design and the manufacturing and integration processes. You'll join a diverse, experienced team with rapidly growing scope while working with one of the industry's most valuable autonomous vehicle datasets.

jobs.title: Director, Advanced Hardware Manufacturing
jobs.description_text: Every Zoox vehicle depends on the electronic and sensor hardware our Advanced Hardware Manufacturing team builds and tests. As Director, you will lead the organization that takes this hardware from early builds to serial volume, helping bring safer, cleaner mobility to cities. Our team values safety first, ownership, and learning together. We solve problems in the open and improve how we work every day. You will be part of the Manufacturing Operations leadership team, reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing Operations. You will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Program Management. This role offers room to grow as our production footprint and team expand.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Marketing and Commercial

Together you will manage planning, forecasting, and performance reporting for Zoox’s marketing and customer promotions investments. You will own the financial models that connect campaigns, discounts, and rider incentives to rider growth, gross bookings, and profitability as Zoox launches its Robotaxi service in new markets. This will require a deep understanding of Zoox’s rider funnel and ridehail economics. It will also require strong working relationships with leaders and individual contributors across multiple departments, and the use of enterprise systems and tools to build robust financial models and dashboards. As a Hardware Engineer on our Test Development team, you will be the hands-on engineer who gets testing done in our Foster City labs. You will build test setups and automation, run tests, and help find the root cause of failures. You will move between projects as needs shift, including next-generation vehicle platforms, production validation for our current robotaxi, and cold-weather qualification. You will use AI tools and automation to build and run tests faster.

Alongside daily triage, you will support core employee lifecycle transactions in Workday, assist managers with everyday system updates, and facilitate seamless, confidential off-boarding and location changes. jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer - Closures
jobs.description_text: Zoox is developing fully autonomous vehicles and the supporting ecosystem required to bring the technology to market at scale. We believe the transition to self-driving vehicles requires a combination of elegant vision and uncompromising execution. The Closures team is responsible for the design, development, and innovation of automated closures systems for our autonomous vehicle. We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, innovative, a self-starter, and excited to work as an exceptional mechatronics engineer. In this role you will own the electromechanical hardware that makes our closures move, including latches, actuators, motors, and sensing. You will improve the systems running in our production fleet while serving as the responsible engineer for that hardware on new vehicle programs.

jobs.title: Operational Strength Attribute Lead, Vehicle Integration
jobs.description_text: At Zoox, we have set the goal of providing our customers with the highest level of safety while using our fully autonomous vehicles. You will work with a team of world-class engineers with diverse backgrounds in robotics, control, and vehicle engineering to deliver vehicle performance. As an Operational Strength Attribute Lead, you will ensure that vehicle structures, systems, and components operate safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their intended lifespan. You will be responsible for evaluating the structural integrity, stiffness, strength, and fatigue resistance of vehicle architectures—such as Body-in-White (BIW), chassis, suspension, closures, and battery enclosures—against real-world operating environments for a robotaxi operating in a dense-urban environment. This role spans the entire product development cycle, balancing requirements definition, computer-aided engineering (CAE) simulations with physical laboratory and track validation to optimize performance and prevent structural failures.

Reporting to the Senior Operations Manager, Manufacturing Operations, you will serve as a point of contact for the VP's office and regularly prepare materials for executive leadership. jobs.title: Senior Manager, R&D Vehicle Production
jobs.description_text: As Senior Manager of R&D Vehicle Production, you will run the prototype vehicle lines at our factory in Fremont, CA. Your team is responsible for building and testing R&D vehicles for mileage collection and software validation, plus early builds of our next-generation ground-up vehicles. You will own assembly, diagnostics, testing, and End-of-Line (EOL), and help carry new vehicles into serial production. Prototype builds surface new hardware and software issues every day. Success in this role depends on working closely with hardware and software engineering teams to resolve them fast, so you can meet production goals. You will set priorities, hold owners accountable, and escalate decisively when an issue blocks the build. Reporting to the Senior Director of Manufacturing Engineering and General Assembly, you will be a key leader in Zoox Manufacturing Operations. You will partner closely with Vehicle Development, Software, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and the teams operating our test fleet.

jobs.title: Senior Manager/Director, Cartography
jobs.description_text: Zoox is building a fully autonomous, purpose-built robotaxi, and high-definition maps are a foundational input to how our vehicles perceive, predict, and plan. As Senior Manager / Director, Cartography, you will lead the organization responsible for creating, maintaining, and validating the HD maps that enable Zoox to launch and scale service across new cities and operational design domains (ODDs). You will manage multiple teams, including in-house cartographers and contractor/vendor mapping teams, and partner closely with Autonomy, Mapping Software, Safety, and Operations to deliver accurate, fresh, and safety-validated maps on schedule.

jobs.title: Senior Optical & Mechanical Engineer (Interior lighting)
jobs.description_text: The Senior Optics Engineer will lead the design, development, optimization and sign-off of innovative optical systems for Interior and exterior lighting products from concept through mass production. Your responsibilities include modeling and simulating optical concepts, specifying and validating optical components, conducting lab experiments and measurements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. This role demands someone who can sprint through design iterations, apply innovative principles of optical engineering, and deliver refined CAD models rapidly. You'll bridge gap between Studio, Engineering, and Suppliers to solve complex optical and manufacturing challenges while maintaining design intent and quality standards.

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description_text: We are inventors, builders, and doers, passionate and purposeful in the work we do. jobs.title: Senior Radar Engineer
jobs.description_text: Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomy Safety Metric
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced engineer to join the Behavior Evaluation team and play a pivotal role in measuring the safety of Zoox’s autonomous driving technology. The Behavior Evaluation is the team behind the behavioral part of Zoox’s estimate, quantifying how often the autonomy stack causes the vehicle to stop unexpectedly and how that maps to collision risk. As a member of this team, you will own and scale the pipeline behind these numbers, driving innovation in ML model scoring, sampling, and projections while making the system faster, more reliable, and easier to audit. You will work closely with a team of talented engineers and researchers in a fast paced, collaborative environment as Zoox expands to more cities and software releases. There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. About Zoox Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. jobs.title: Senior Staff/Principal Software Engineer - GPU System Software, Onboard Execution
jobs.description_text: Zoox is building the world's most advanced self-driving hardware and software solution. This role offers a unique opportunity to join a team spinning up from the ground up in our Tel Aviv office (located right next to the train station, operating on a hybrid schedule). We have the data, GPUs, and tokens needed, and we ship directly to production to make an impact on a product that is actually doing good in the real world. We are looking for a highly motivated individual passionate about pushing the boundaries of Spatial AI in the autonomous vehicle space.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Core Connectivity
jobs.description_text: Zoox is building the world's most advanced self-driving hardware and software solution, and nearly every part of it depends on moving data reliably. Sensor frames to perception, planner decisions to vehicle controls, telemetry to the cloud, and remote operator video back down again. All of it crosses process, host, and network boundaries under hard latency and reliability budgets, on a vehicle that has to keep working when a link degrades or a network gets congested. The Software Core Connectivity team owns that data path end to end: in-vehicle messaging (pub/sub, RPC, inter-process and inter-host transport), the vehicle's internal network, and vehicle-to-cloud connectivity. It also owns the transport and serialization abstractions the rest of the software organization builds on. Every one of those paths crosses a team boundary, so the work happens alongside firmware, product security, simulation, manufacturing, and IT, and those partners rely on this team for transport and networking depth to achieve their goals. As the team leader you will own the roadmap and the release commitments, and you will spend a real share of your time in those partnerships.
